'''Angus Laride''' was an individual who worked for [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Laride was working as a field correspondent for HoloNet News on [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]]. During the [[Battle of Jabiim]], HoloNet News lost contact with both Laride and [[Jabiimi Loyalists]] [[spokesbeing]] [[Orliss Gillmunn]].<ref name="Insider 69" />
